data.title: Immutable Software Deploys Using ZFS Jails on FreeBSD
data.author: vermaden
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了如何在FreeBSD上使用ZFS和Jails实现不可变部署。通过ZFS快照创建新的Jail来发布每个版本，可以实现即时回滚、零停机升级和干净可重现的环境。主要内容包括：1）系统要求（FreeBSD 14+、ZFS和Caddy）；2）架构概述（Caddy反向代理、ZFS快照/Jail和应用的关系）；3）配置Jails主机服务器（创建网络接口、启用Jail服务）；4）构建基础镜像模板（下载FreeBSD镜像并创建ZFS快照）；5）创建新Jail（克隆基础模板并配置）。这种方法提供了可靠的部署机制，特别适合需要高可用性的生产环境。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[FreeBSD jails与容器化技术的对比及实现方式的讨论]

不同观点：
• [cullumsmith] 推荐使用FreeBSD jails和自定义脚本jailctl，强调ZFS模板和VNET jails的优势，特别是通过持久化的ZFS数据集“data”来分离OS和应用数据。
• [inopinatus] 分享了在Illumos上使用ZFS克隆和iSCSI的经验，建议现在可能更倾向于使用文件系统级别的ZFS克隆和NFS。
• [fsmv] 提出了一个反向代理服务器的解决方案，自动配置HTTPS和内部通信，但目前处于更新中。
• [soupbowl] 指出对于不熟悉FreeBSD的用户，可以使用现成的jail管理器来简化操作。
• [AdieuToLogic] 推荐ezjail作为另一种实现类似目标的工具。
• [righthand] 推荐使用Bastille FreeBSD来简化ZFS克隆和管理，类似于Docker的工具。
• [fukka42] 质疑FreeBSD jails是否是Docker的复杂版本，引发争议。

补充讨论：
• [dzogchen] 询问fsmv的守护进程是否会在崩溃时重启。
• [nesarkvechnep] 希望OCI容器的支持能够简化现有的样板代码。
• [evanjrowley] 提供了一个详细的教程链接。

争议焦点：
• FreeBSD jails与Docker的优劣对比，以及是否值得投入额外精力使用FreeBSD jails。

45852895.article_content:
Immutable Software Deploys Using ZFS Jails on FreeBSD
freebsd
caddy
devops
November 6, 2025
FreeBSD’s native support for ZFS snapshots and jails provides a powerful foundation for immutable deployments. By creating a new jail from a ZFS snapshot for every release, we get instant roll‑backs, zero‑downtime upgrades, and a clean, reproducible environment. This article walks through the (very opinionated) flow that we use. From jails setup through running
Caddy
as a health‑checked reverse proxy in front of the jails.
1. Prerequisites
FreeBSD 14+ (or the latest stable release) offers the necessary ZFS and jail primitives. Enabling ZFS with a zpool installed allows cheap, instant cloning. The Caddy v2 binary handles TLS, reverse-proxying, and health checks.
2. Architecture Overview
+--------------------+      +------------------------+      +-------------------+
|                    |      |                        |      |                   |
|   Caddy (reverse   | <->  |  Immutable Jails       | <->  |  Application      |
|   proxy & health-  |      |  (ZFS snapshot/clone)  |      |  inside each jail |
|   check)           |      |                        |      |                   |
|                    |      |                        |      |                   |
+--------------------+      +------------------------+      +-------------------+
Caddy routes to the currently healthy jail.
Each deployment clones a ZFS snapshot → new jail.
After passing health‑checks, Caddy reconfigures to the new jail.
3. Configure the Jails Host Server
Create a new loopback network interface for the jails. We'll use 172.16.0.0/12 which means jails can use any IP address within the range 172.16.0.1 – 172.31.255.254. Then create a new service to manage the loopback interface via a file at '/usr/local/etc/rc.d/lo1' with the following content:
#!/bin/sh
# PROVIDE: lo1
# REQUIRE: NETWORKING
# BEFORE:  jail
# KEYWORD: shutdown
. /etc/rc.subr
name="lo1"
command="ifconfig"
start_cmd="${command} ${name} create && ${command} ${name} inet 172.16.0.1 netmask 255.240.0.0 up"
stop_cmd="${command} ${name} down"
run_rc_command "$1"
Then make the service start at boot and enable it:
chmod +x /usr/local/etc/rc.d/lo1
sysrc lo1_enable="YES"
service lo1 start
Now we can go onwards to enabling jails:
sysrc jail_enable="YES"
sysrc jail_parallel_start="YES"
Create a /etc/jail.conf file with the below configurations so that it includes the configurations for each jail.
NOTE: Each jail configuration should be placed in a separate file in '/etc/jail.conf.d/'.
NOTE: The leading '.' before include is required.
.include "/etc/jail.conf.d/*.conf";
Create a ZFS dataset mount point and paths for the jails:
zfs create -o mountpoint=/usr/local/jails zroot/jails
Create child datasets for the jails:
# Contains the compressed files of the downloaded userlands.
zfs create zroot/jails/media
# Will contain the templates.
zfs create zroot/jails/templates
# Will contain the containers.
zfs create zroot/jails/containers
4. Build the Base Image Template
Download the base FreeBSD image and unpack it:
# Set environment variable for the FreeBSD version. Note that the cut is to remove the patch level.
export FREEBSD_VERSION=$(freebsd-version | cut -d- -f1-2)
zfs create -p zroot/jails/templates/$FREEBSD_VERSION
fetch https://download.freebsd.org/ftp/releases/$(uname -m)/$FREEBSD_VERSION/base.txz -o /usr/local/jails/media/$FREEBSD_VERSION-base.txz
tar -xf /usr/local/jails/media/$FREEBSD_VERSION-base.txz -C /usr/local/jails/templates/$FREEBSD_VERSION --unlink
Copy critical files to the image template:
cp /etc/resolv.conf /usr/local/jails/templates/$FREEBSD_VERSION/etc/resolv.conf
cp /etc/localtime /usr/local/jails/templates/$FREEBSD_VERSION/etc/localtime
Update the image template to the latest patch level.
freebsd-update -b /usr/local/jails/templates/$FREEBSD_VERSION fetch install
Finally, create a ZFS snapshot of the base image template. From this snapshot we we'll use ZFS clones to create new jails.
zfs snapshot zroot/jails/templates/$FREEBSD_VERSION@base
5. Create a New Jail
Check which ip addresses on the 'lo1' loopback interface are in use so that we can assign an available ip address to the new jail.
ifconfig lo1 | grep 'inet ' | awk '{print $2}'
Lookup the git repo commit hash for the latest commit.
git ls-remote https://github.com/yourusername/mygitrepo.git | head
Clone the base image template to create a new jail. We'll be creating a new jail within our git repo path.
export FREEBSD_VERSION=$(freebsd-version | cut -d- -f1-2)
export JAIL_NAME=mygitrepo_gitSHA
zfs clone zroot/jails/templates/$FREEBSD_VERSION@base zroot/jails/containers/$JAIL_NAME
Create a config file for the jail to be located at '/etc/jail.conf.d/$JAIL_NAME.conf'.
We name the jail using the SHA of the git commit that we're deploying.
mygitrepo_gitSHA {
# STARTUP/LOGGING
exec.start = "/bin/sh /etc/rc";
exec.stop = "/bin/sh /etc/rc.shutdown";
exec.consolelog = "/var/log/jail_console_${name}.log";
# PERMISSION

data.title: The Initial Ideal Customer Profile Worksheet
data.author: mrbbk
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了一个初始理想客户画像（IICP）工作表，帮助企业选择第一个目标买家角色进行营销。作者建议从三个候选角色开始，通过三个评估标准（产品优势、市场规模和分销策略）进行筛选，并提供了详细的问卷模板和评分方法。文章强调应选择最熟悉的客户群体，这样更容易进行有效沟通和精准营销。最后给出了实操建议，包括确保角色选择与市场进入策略相匹配，诚实地评估分销能力，并提前构思针对该角色的营销内容。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[在产品开发初期是否应该专注于单一用户画像（persona）以及如何平衡广泛探索与专注的关系]

不同观点：
• **支持初期专注于单一用户画像**  
  - [whinvik]认为找到一个核心用户画像有助于避免开发过于分散，但强调不应过早锁定，初期需广泛探索，找到真正有增长潜力的画像后再专注。  
  - [lokimedes]建议通过测试用户支付意愿（WtP）来验证假设，避免过早依赖理想化的画像模型。

• **反对过早锁定单一用户画像**  
  - [brudgers]指出早期过度依赖想象中的理想用户可能导致与实际需求脱节，强调需通过真实用户反馈调整策略。  
  - [ahaucnx]以AirGradient为例，说明单一画像可能忽略实际决策复杂性（如学校案例中决策者与受益者分离），主张初期采取更广泛的探索。

• **关于营销与用户沟通的补充讨论**  
  - [neilv]引用外部观点，强调“真实沟通”（authentic communication）比“说服”更重要，认为营销的核心是真诚而非技巧。

补充讨论：
- **争议焦点**：是否应在产品初期阶段投入大量资源优化单一用户画像，还是通过广泛测试验证假设。  
- **关键论据**：  
  - 支持方：专注可提高效率，但需以验证为前提（如WtP测试）。  
  - 反对方：真实用户行为复杂（如决策链、价值观差异），过早聚焦可能限制机会。  
- **实践案例**：AirGradient的学校市场失败揭示了画像与实际场景的潜在 mismatch。

45801651.article_content:
The Initial Ideal Customer Profile (IICP) Worksheet
by Michael Bernstein on January 30, 2023
When it comes to determining who to market to, we’re big believers in the idea that, to start,
you only need one buyer persona
. If you’re wondering how we arrived at that conclusion, check out the post from 2018 and then come back here for some good next steps. If you’re convinced that walking before you run is the right way to approach persona-driven marketing, and you’re wondering how to choose which persona to start with, then the rest of this post is for you.
The essential question is –
If you only need one buyer persona (for now), how do you choose which one to start with?
This worksheet and accompanying documentation is designed to help you decide.
Evaluation criteria
Our evaluation framework is based on these three pillars of persona validation:
Product Strength
- How good is your product in the eyes of this potential audience?
Market Size
- Is this persona’s segment too niche? Or not niche enough?
Distribution Strategy
- Assuming this is the right persona, how are you going to reach them, and can you communicate with them authentically?
First, start out by listing the personas you’re considering marketing to. We recommend limiting this initial list to just three personas – and make sure they’re different enough to warrant the kind of scrutiny we’re about to put them through. If you’re unsure of how to generate this list,
this post can help you with that
.
The Questionnaire
Next, for each of these personas, fill out the following questionnaire. You can also invite anyone on your team to fill it out. If you’re going to take that approach, we recommend sending out a brief description of each of the personas you’re considering, so that everyone is as calibrated as possible when it comes time to evaluate them.
We’ve also
the form  available in Google Doc format here
.
A rubric: What to do with the results?
If you want to take a quantitative approach to your decision, or make a
data-driven decision
, you can score each candidate according to the following point values for each value in the Likert scale style questions:
Zero Confidence:
-2
Not very Confident:
-1
Neutral/Unsure:
0
Very Confident:
1
Nearly Certain:
2
As a start, you can judge the overall confidence you have in each of your potential candidates. Keep in mind that that assumes that each of the questions and pillars are equally impactful – a question that is open for debate.
When it comes down to it, we essentially recommend that you
go with the group you know the best.
You’re going to be able to clearly see who you’re able to fill out all of these questions for, and who you aren’t. You  may have a gut feeling that chasing after a particularly hot segment right now (“AI Infrastructure Engineers”) might be a good long-term strategy, but it might not be, if you don’t know them well. Going with the group you know the best will give you the best opportunity to effectively measure your messaging and positioning to a well-defined group who you know how to communicate with.
Join our email list to get our writing in your inbox.
The fact of the matter is, if you attempt to target a market segment that you don’t know how to authentically with, you might have a hard time getting off the ground. Additionally, if it’s not a segment you knwo very well, how sure can you be that you’ve built a product that will uniquely benefit them?
Some more tips on getting the most out of this process:
Recognize that persona choice and go-to-market motions are inextricably linked.
If you don’t want to be involved in a top-down motion involving enterprise sales and a lot of contract negotiation, make sure your persona isn’t “CTO” or “VP of Eng at a $100MM ARR Software Company”
Be brutally honest with yourself about Question #3 specifically.
If you’re confident about #1 and #2, but have no ideas about #3, you might want to reconsider your approach
Imagine yourself putting together a landing page or marketing site home page directed toward this persona
– can you start to visualize the necessary content to entice this individual?
You’ve chosen – now what?
Once you’ve made the decision to start with one of your personas, what should you do next? We recommend thinking more about how you’re going to communicate with them. It’s time to
think about the Value Story
.

data.title: 52 Year old data tape could contain Unix history
data.author: rbanffy
data.article_summary: 美国犹他大学在清理储藏室时发现了一盘1973年的9轨磁带，标记为贝尔实验室的UNIX第四版原始版本。这可能是现存唯一的完整副本，特别珍贵的是该版本首次用C语言重写了内核和核心工具。磁带将由工作人员亲自送往加州计算机历史博物馆进行数据恢复。博物馆专家表示将优先处理这盘磁带，使用专业设备进行读取。这一发现对计算机历史研究具有重要意义。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[关于1973年Unix V4源代码磁带的发现及其历史意义和技术挑战]

不同观点：
• **历史保存的重要性**
  - [jleyank]认为计算机领域忽视了历史，而其他领域（如历史学和物理学）更重视保存和研究过去的成就。
  - [notorandit]持混合态度，认为虽然值得保存，但不应无限保留所有人类创作。

• **技术挑战与恢复可能性**
  - [Tor3]分享了自己成功读取1982年磁带的经验，提到清洁磁带头的关键作用。
  - [Animats]表示怀疑，认为自己的UNIVAC磁带可能无法读取，因为缺乏合适的驱动器。
  - [jmpman]乐观认为IBM的磁带实验室可以恢复52年前的磁带数据。

• **未来应用与兴趣**
  - [gxd]希望创建一个模拟环境来编译和运行Unix V4，表达了对技术重现的兴趣。
  - [anthk]建议使用Simh模拟器来运行这些代码。
  - [deadbabe]询问代码是否会公开发布到GitHub。

补充讨论：
- [drob518]提到Al Capone的保险库事件，暗示可能存在失望的风险。
- [1970-01-01]幽默地提到月球迷失磁带，增加了讨论的趣味性。
- [lproven]确认了原始文章的来源，体现了社区互动。

45857695.article_content:
OSes
27
Bell bottom-era tape unearthed, could contain lost piece of Unix history
27
It might have the first-ever version of UNIX written in C
Liam Proven
Fri 7 Nov 2025
//
18:46 UTC
A tape-based piece of unique Unix history may have been lying quietly in storage at the University of Utah for 50+ years. The question is whether researchers will be able to take this piece of middle-aged media and rewind it back to the 1970s to get the data off.
The news was
posted to Mastodon
by
Professor Robert Ricci
of the University of Utah's
Kahlert School of Computing
.
While cleaning a storage room, our staff found this tape containing #UNIX v4 from Bell Labs, circa 1973
Apparently no other complete copies are known to exist:
https://gunkies.org/wiki/UNIX_Fourth_Edition
We have arranged to deliver it to the Computer History Museum
The nine-track tape reel bears a handwritten label reading:
UNIX Original From Bell Labs V4 (See Manual for format)
Ricci says that the handwriting on the label is that of his former advisor
Jay Lepreau
[PDF], who
died of multiple myeloma in 2008
.
If it's what it says on the label, this is a notable discovery because
little of UNIX V4
remains. That's unfortunate as this specific version is especially interesting: it's the first version of UNIX in which the kernel and some of the core utilities were rewritten in the new C programming language. Until now, the only surviving parts known were the
source code
to a slightly older version of the kernel and a few
man
pages
– plus the
Programmer's Manual
[PDF], from November 1973.
More was to follow – some hours later,
he continued
:
We have some more information on this! One of
@regehr
's
grad students
did some excellent sleuthing and figured out that this was received by Martin Newell:
https://archive.org/details/unix_news_july-30-1975/page/n9/mode/2up
If that name sounds familiar to you, it's probably because his teapot is ubiquitous in computer graphics:
https://graphics.cs.utah.edu/teapot/
So, this is the original copy of UNIX Fourth Edition received from AT&T by the inventor of the Utah Teapot – as seen in the
original Windows NT OpenGL screensaver
.
The elusive goal of Unix – or Linux – simplicity
Forgetting the history of Unix is coding us into a corner
Beta of Unix version 2 restored to life
The Unix Epochalypse might be sooner than you think
Ricci
said
:
The staff member who found it is planning to drive it to the CHM, rather than ship it.
That being the
Computer History Museum
in Mountain View, California – which Google Maps tells us is a mere 771 miles away, a modest 12 hours' drive. The software librarian at the CHM is the redoubtable
Al Kossow of Bitsavers
, who
commented
in the thread that he is on the case. On the TUHS mailing list, he
explained
how he plans to do it:
taping off the head read amplifier, using a multi-channel high speed analog to digital converter which dumps into 100-ish gigabytes of RAM, then an analysis program Len Shustek wrote:
https://github.com/LenShustek/readtape
It is a '70s 1200ft 3M tape, likely 9 track, which has a pretty good chance of being recoverable.
He also
noted
:
This is rare enough that I'm pushing the recovery of it up near the top of my project queue.
The
Reg
FOSS desk has occasionally corresponded with Kossow, and we feel sure that this precious find could be in no better hands. ®

data.title: Avería: The Average Font (2011)
data.author: JoshTriplett
data.article_summary: 本文讲述了作者创造新字体“Avería”的过程。作者通过对计算机上所有字体进行平均化处理，尝试生成一种新型字体。最初采用叠加透明度的方法，后来探索更复杂的形状平均技术。在经历多次实验和学习贝塞尔曲线、字体度量等知识后，最终完成了这个项目。字体名称“Avería”源自西班牙语，意为“平均”和“机械故障”，作者认为这个双重含义很有趣。最终字体以SIL开放字体许可证发布，供所有人自由使用。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[Averia字体作为系统字体平均化的实验结果，其设计特点、实用性及美学感受]

不同观点：
• **支持Averia的美学与实用性**  
  - [jslabovitz]：认为Averia（尤其是Serif Libre版本）极具可读性且 calming，适合长期阅读和写作，尽管自己作为专业排版师，仍偏爱其“不突出”的特质。  
  - [crazygringo]：欣赏其“不显眼”的特性，提议将其作为设计基础，经过调整后成为理想的阅读字体。  
  - [seabass]：整体评价积极，认为其可读性高，仅需微调个别字符（如Q和4）。  

• **批评Averia的视觉缺陷**  
  - [0_____0]：认为字体看起来“模糊”且不协调，字母形态杂乱（如m的驼峰不对称、高度随机），需大量手动调整才能实用。  
  - [jen729w]：嘲讽Averia与Lato类似，暗指其平庸（Lato被描述为“execrable”）。  

• **中立或关联性评论**  
  - [JoshTriplett]：将Averia比作AI生成文字的“恐怖谷”效果，强调其统计学平均特性。  
  - [zeroq]：类比Old Timey字体，指出Averia的“墨水感”和偶然性瑕疵。  
  - [moss_dog]：引申讨论衍生作品的版权问题，类似AI训练的争议。  

补充讨论：  
- **争议焦点**：Averia是否因“平均化”导致美学牺牲（如模糊、不协调）还是成就了独特的实用性（如可读性、低调）。  
- **文化彩蛋**：[peter-m80]指出“Avería”在西班牙语中意为“失败”，引发幽默联想。  
- **实际应用**：[msk-lywenn]提到Averia被用于视觉小说，[tiltowait]考虑在电子阅读器上使用。  
- **其他关联字体**：[cernocky]提及Supernormal字体，[october8140]提供Google Fonts链接。

45859243.article_content:
am not a type designer.
T
his is the story of the creation
of a new font,
Avería: the average of all the fonts on my computer. The field of typography
has long fascinated me, and I love playing with creative programming
ideas, so it was perhaps inevitable that the idea came to me one day of
“generative typography”. A
Google
on the subject brought up little, and I
put the idea to the back of my mind until it occurred to me that perhaps the process of
averaging, or interpolating, existing fonts might bring up interesting results. Luckily at this
point I didn't do any more web searching – instead I grabbed
my laptop and came up with an initial idea for finding what the average of all
my fonts might look like – by overlaying each letter at low opacity. The results
can be seen in the below image.
This was done by printing each letter of each font, at the same point size,
to lots of separate images, and then averaging them – using
ImageMagick
and
PHP
.
The letters were
aligned to the same centre point. I later realised that each font has a
‘baseline’
defined, and
an
origin
on that baseline which each glyph is drawn relative to. The same process,
repeated with equal origins, gives slightly different results (see below) – here
you can see the baseline is very well-defined, with the glyphs becoming more blurred towards the top right of each.
I was quite pleased with the results. It was only later that I discovered
this had already been done
– though it appeared that my end results (whilst not as beautifully animated) had a little
more clarity, so I'm glad I tried for myself. But this didn't seem like the end of
the journey. Whilst this was an  interesting experiment, and showed an lot of
correlation between a sample of common fonts (as well as a
couple of oddities – notably the lower case ‘g’ which clearly exists in two
distinct common forms), what I really wanted was an average which somehow
preserved the well-defined edges of existing fonts. So I started considering ways to
produce a smoother, sharper average of letter forms.
One idea which seemed obvious was to simply take the blurry results of the
first experiment, and use a threshold to create monochrome images. A few experiments in this
direction (I first tried with a lower-case ‘f’, which I later found was never
likely to give good results due to the variance in height of the middle
cross-stroke) convinced me that I needed to look into cleverer ways to achieve
this
.
Surely there must be a simple way to average shapes, while keeping the result as a
shape?
It turns out not to be straightforward. There are
many
possible
ways
to ‘morph’ between two shapes – and what might seem the most natural
generally depends on our perception of ‘features’ in the shapes. Consider the
average of a capital I with serifs, and one without: the natural thing to do
would be something like, make the serifs half as big, and use a horizontal stem
width about half-way between the two glyphs. That's two feature concepts being
applied to the abstract forms
¹
. To take a simpler example, what is the
average of a square with the same square rotated 45˚? There are a few
possibilities …
So, this stumped me for a while. I decided I needed to get to know fonts
better, so I built
a simple web app
to view the lines, curves and control points
present in the fonts I had. On this basis, I started to consider the ways the
features (vertices, curves, stems, serifs etc) might be matched up between fonts.
However, this was a rabbit hole I might never get to the bottom of -
particularly when considering some of the more unusual varieties of font.
Perhaps there was a simpler idea that was evading me.
Then it occurred to me: since my aim was to average a large number of fonts,
perhaps it would be best to use a very simple process, and hope the results
averaged out well over a large number of fonts. So, how about splitting each
letter perimeter into lots of (say, 500) equally-spaced points, and just average
between the corresponding positions of each, on each letter? It would be necessary to match up the points so
they were about the same location in each letter, and then the process would be
fairly simple
²
.
Having found a simple process to use, I was ready to start. And after about a month of
part-time slaving away (sheer fun! Better than any computer game) – in the
process of which I learned lots about bezier curves and font metrics – I had a
result. I call it Avería – which is a Spanish word related to
the root of the
word ‘average’
. It actually means mechanical breakdown or damage. This seemed curiously fitting, and I was
assured by a Spanish friend-of-a-friend that “Avería is an incredibly beautiful
word regardless of its meaning”. So that's nice.
Along the way I naturally called on the counsel of the best designers
I know – my brother
Nick Sayers
,
Lloyd Thomas
,
Tom Muller
and
Chris McGrail
, for
advice. In the end, I decided to release the font using the
SIL Open Font
License
– which means anyon

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[浏览器平滑滚动的实现方式及其用户体验]

不同观点：
• [反对强制JS平滑滚动]  
  - 用户lacoolj认为浏览器本身已支持平滑滚动，开发者不应强制使用JS实现，这会导致用户体验下降，甚至引发用户反感（如直接关闭页面）。
  - 论据：用户可能已禁用系统默认平滑滚动，JS强制覆盖会破坏用户偏好。

• [历史讨论的补充]  
  - 用户gnabgib提供了历史讨论链接，指向2017年和2019年相关话题，表明争议长期存在且热度较高（两次讨论均获近400点赞和大量评论）。

• [技术实现疑问]  
  - 用户emoII从技术角度提出疑问，认为逆向实现中间语言会导致开发逻辑混乱，需预先知道下一阶段的输入输出才能设计当前阶段。  
  - 争议焦点：开发流程的合理性（“契约反向”是否可行）。

补充讨论：
- 强制JS平滑滚动可能引发用户隐私或控制权争议（如覆盖系统设置）。  
- 历史讨论链接显示该问题涉及技术选择与用户自由的平衡。

data.title: Largest cargo sailboat completes first Atlantic crossing
data.author: defrost
data.article_summary: 全球最大货运帆船“Neoliner Origin”号于10月30日完成首航跨大西洋之旅，虽途中遭遇风暴导致后帆受损，仍借助辅助动力系统抵达美国巴尔的摩。这艘136米长的法国滚装船配备两具半刚性帆，相较传统柴油货轮可减少80%-90%的温室气体排放。英国研究显示，此类风帆推进系统在新船上可减排超50%。该船由法国Mauric公司设计，融合现代导航与自动化系统，载重5300吨，将维持每月一次欧美航线的商业运营。制造商强调其兼顾工业需求与环保责任的特点，突显风能作为免费清洁能源的优势。（199字）
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[风力货轮的可行性、优缺点及与其他运输方式的比较]

不同观点：
• **支持风力货轮的观点**  
  - Aurornis认为这是一种有益的尝试，即使不完全依赖风力也值得推广。  
  - aerostable_slug认为这是未来的方向，尽管存在技术挑战（如维护和船员问题）。  
  - 评论提到Neoliner Origin能减少80-90%的温室气体排放，环保优势明显。

• **质疑风力货轮的观点**  
  - BurningFrog指出其载货量（5300吨）远低于传统集装箱船（15-25万吨），实用性存疑。  
  - turpialito通过计算对比，风力货轮速度（11节）显著低于传统货轮（25节），运输时间更长。  

• **其他替代方案**  
  - thelastgallon和krasin提到核动力货船的可能性，尤其是中国正在研发的核动力集装箱船（载货量1.4万箱，无需频繁加油）。  
  - ForHackernews提出更激进的方案，如用高空风筝牵引船舶。  

补充讨论：  
- **争议焦点**：风力货轮的实用性与经济性是否足以取代传统船舶。支持者强调环保优势，反对者则关注载货量和速度的短板。  
- **补充信息**：Neoliner Origin的载重吨位在大型帆船中名列前茅（13,278 GT），但与传统货轮差距仍然显著。  
- **乘客服务**：nullhole提到该船提供客运服务（€3200/人，13天航程），附带舒适设施，可能成为小众选择。

45859471.article_content:
Image Credits: NEOLINE/LinkedIn
The world’s largest cargo sailboat, Neoliner Origin, completed its first transatlantic voyage on 30 October despite damage to one of its sails during the journey.
The 136-metre-long vessel had to rely partly on its auxiliary motor and its remaining sail after the aft sail was damaged in a storm shortly after departure.
The French-built roll-on/roll-off (RoRo) cargo ship, which has two semi-rigid sails, first stopped at Saint Pierre and Miquelon, a French overseas territory near Canada, before continuing its journey to Baltimore in the United States.
Neoline, the company behind the project, said the damage reduced the vessel’s ability to perform fully on wind power. The company’s CEO, Jean Zanuttini, said the crossing was a valuable experience in handling large sail surfaces across the North Atlantic, especially during late-season storms. He added that despite the difficulties, the ship showed strong resilience by reaching its destination with only a short delay in Saint Pierre.
The Neoliner Origin is designed to reduce greenhouse gas emissions by 80 to 90 per cent compared to conventional diesel-powered cargo ships. According to the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD), global shipping produces about 3 per cent of worldwide greenhouse gas emissions.
Zanuttini said the company aims to balance industrial needs with environmental responsibility. He added that wind propulsion offers an advantage because it is a free, widely available, and predictable energy source that does not harm ecosystems.
Image Credits: NEOLINE/LinkedIn
The UK’s National Clean Maritime Research Hub has reported that wind propulsion systems like those on the Neoliner Origin can cut emissions by over 50 per cent on new vessels optimised for wind conditions. Retrofitted vessels can also achieve reductions of 5 to 20 per cent, and up to 30 per cent when adjusted for wind conditions.
The Neoliner Origin was designed by the French naval engineering firm Mauric. The company’s CEO, Vincent Seguin, said the goal was to develop a ship that relies primarily on wind propulsion while ensuring consistent delivery schedules and efficient operation with a smaller crew.
Inspired by historic sailing vessels, the Neoliner Origin integrates modern systems such as advanced navigation, anti-drift mechanisms, and automated sail management to comply with current safety and operational standards.
The ship can carry up to 5,300 tonnes of cargo, including containers, vehicles, machinery, and specialised goods. It arrived in Baltimore carrying Renault vehicles, French liqueurs, machinery, and other products.
The Neoliner Origin is scheduled to make monthly voyages between Europe and North America, maintaining a commercial cruising speed of around 11 knots.

data.title: Ironclad – formally verified, real-time capable, Unix-like OS kernel
data.author: vitalnodo
data.article_summary: Ironclad是一款经过形式化验证、支持实时调度的类UNIX操作系统内核，适用于通用和嵌入式场景。它采用SPARK/Ada编写，100%自由开源，兼容POSIX标准，支持强制访问控制（MAC）和硬实时调度。核心优势包括：完全开源（GPLv3许可）、通过形式化验证确保关键模块正确性、良好的可移植性，以及基于POSIX的软件生态兼容性。项目通过欧盟NGI Zero Core基金和NLnet资助，接受社区捐赠以持续发展。主要发行版为Gloire，支持多平台架构。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[Ironclad OS项目的正式验证、成熟度、适用性及开源状态]

不同观点：
• **对正式验证的质疑**  
  - [AlotOfReading]认为当前验证仅停留在基础层面（"stone level"），可能无法满足硬实时需求。  
  - [lovidico]批评其验证范围有限，缺乏类似seL4的重要属性证明，描述存在误导性。  
  - [beanjuiceII]和[alberth]指出官网明确标注“部分验证”，但后者质疑SPARK的付费许可是否与“100%自由软件”声明冲突。

• **与其他项目的比较**  
  - [AlotOfReading]提到seL4、Genode等已验证内核，认为POSIX兼容性+WCET+验证的组合罕见。  
  - [jonjacky]补充CuBit（SPARK/Ada系统）作为同类案例。  
  - [tombert]对完全验证内核（如seL4）的未来持乐观态度，但认为Linux已无法实现全面验证。

• **实际应用与生态担忧**  
  - [AlotOfReading]和[anta40]指出内核需配套生态（如Gloire OS）才有实际价值。  
  - [notepad0x90]强调固件层安全性是关键瓶颈，呼吁验证硬件固件（如Framework电脑）。  
  - [nacozarina]质疑SPARK的“免费”标签可能隐含商业限制。

补充讨论：
- **争议焦点**：SPARK的许可性质（自由软件vs付费）与验证的实际深度是否匹配宣传。  
- **技术细节**：[liamkinne]询问缺乏ARM64支持的原因，反映架构适配的开放性疑问。  
- **行业趋势**：多位用户（如tombert、notepad0x90）讨论验证技术在智能手机/硬件领域的潜在应用。

45860843.article_content:
The Ironclad Operating System Kernel
Ironclad is a
formally verified
, real-time capable, UNIX-like
operating system kernel for general-purpose and embedded uses. It is written in
SPARK
and
Ada
, and
is comprised of 100% free software.
Ironclad features a familiar
POSIX
-compatible interface, true
simultaneous preemptive multitasking,
Mandatory Access Control (MAC)
,
and support for hard real-time scheduling.
Download a distribution
Download an Ironclad tarball
Why Choose Ironclad?
Free as in freedom
Ironclad is fully open source and distributed under the
GPLv3
, ensuring
it remains free. No firmware blobs are needed or shipped with the
kernel. Every piece of the stack is open source.
Formal verification
SPARK
's state of the art
formal verification
is employed for ensuring
absence of errors and correctness of huge swathes of Ironclad, like
cryptography,
MAC
, and user-facing facilities.
Portable
Ported to several platforms and boards, and designed to be easily
portable to many more. Dependency on only the GNU toolchain
allows for easy cross-compilation.
Distributions and ecosystem
POSIX
compatibility makes software porting and development easy.
The project features distributions ready for download and use for
all the available architectures and boards, the most prominent FOSS one
is
Gloire
.
Who pays for Ironclad?
Ironclad will always be free for use, study, and
modification
, so, to support the project, we rely on the use of
donations and grants. Every contribution makes a difference and
allows us to do more.
Donate
Thanks to
This project is funded through
NGI Zero Core
, a fund established by
NLnet
with financial support from the European Commission's
Next Generation Internet program
. Learn
more at the
NLnet project page
.

data.title: Debugging BeagleBoard USB boot with a sniffer: fixing omap_loader on modern PCs
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: 本文讲述了作者尝试在2008年的BeagleBoard（OMAP3530）上实现USB启动的过程。作者在研究过程中遇到了UART驱动问题，随后决定尝试USB启动功能。他找到了一个名为omap_loader的工具，但由于硬件年代久远，相关文档和信息大多已消失或失效。在尝试使用现代计算机进行USB启动时，作者遇到了libusb传输错误，最终发现只有在较旧的没有USB 3.0接口的计算机上才能成功运行。文章主要展示了作者在调试过程中的技术挑战和对老旧硬件支持的探索。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[互联网档案馆的作用、USB嗅探器的可靠性、OMAP USB的技术问题]

不同观点：
• [互联网档案馆的重要性]
  - CheeseFromLidl强调互联网档案馆在保存老旧硬件资源方面的关键作用，并呼吁捐赠支持。
  - 例子：当处理10年前的硬件时，经常遇到资源不可用的问题，互联网档案馆提供了帮助。

• [USB嗅探器的争议]
  - Tor3对USB嗅探器感兴趣，但对其来源和可靠性表示担忧。
  - 例子：AliExpress销售的预建板可能存在假货或不可靠的问题，与原始开发者Taradov的警告一致。

• [OMAP USB的技术问题]
  - gadiyar作为前TI员工，对OMAP USB的技术问题表示兴趣，并询问是否在linux-usb邮件列表中讨论过。
  - 例子：gadiyar提到自己曾参与Linux驱动开发，但对启动行为的ROM代码不直接负责。

补充讨论：
• Tor3对USB嗅探器的兴趣与开发者警告之间的冲突，凸显了开源硬件市场中假货问题的普遍性。
• gadiyar的评论引发了关于OMAP USB技术问题是否在开源社区中得到充分讨论的疑问。

Downtown Doug Brown
Thoughts from a combined Apple/Linux/Windows geek.
Home
About
Mac ROM SIMMs
Software
Microcontroller lessons
Contact
Nov
08
Debugging BeagleBoard USB boot with a sniffer: fixing omap_loader on modern PCs
Doug Brown
Bug fixes
,
Linux
2025-11-08
This post is about the original
OMAP3530 BeagleBoard
from 2008. Yes, the one so old that it doesn’t even show up in
the board list on BeagleBoard.org
anymore. The Beagle
Board
, not the BeagleBone. During my Chumby 8 kernel escapades, at one point
I ran into a UART bug that affected multiple drivers
, including the omap-serial driver. This led me to buy a BeagleBoard so I could verify the omap-serial bug on hardware.
After I figured out the bug with the UART driver, I realized that the OMAP3530 has support for booting from USB, so I decided to go off on a random tangent to get USB boot working. There was no problem I was trying to solve or anything like that. I just thought it would be a fun experiment (am I a masochist?). Little did I know, I would be getting myself into some tricky USB packet analysis.
I struggled to find info about this process because of how old the OMAP is today. The main utility I found was a program called
omap_loader
by Grant Hernandez, which is a newer rewrite of Martin Mueller’s original
omap3_usbload
circa 2008. Thanks to some lucky searching combined with the Internet Archive, I connected the dots between 2008 and the present. At some point before 2013, Rick Bronson
provided an update to omap3_usbload (along with a patch to TI’s X-Loader bootloader)
that enabled uploading additional files like a full U-Boot and Linux kernel into RAM after X-Loader, all through USB. This unlocked the ability to boot all the way to Linux from a completely blank BeagleBoard. Grant’s newer omap_loader utility also incorporates these same improvements.
All of this research was difficult. Many of the links I found pointed to sites like gitorious.org and arago-project.org, both of which no longer exist (although Arago’s Git repos are now
hosted by TI
). eLinux.org’s BeagleBoard wiki was totally rearranged at some point and lost its info about USB recovery, and Rick’s site no longer exists, but as usual, the Internet Archive saved the day.
At some point later on, X-Loader was replaced by U-Boot SPL, so I think that is partially why so much of this info eventually disappeared from the web. But it’s a darn shame. This USB booting functionality is really cool, and it seems like most of the documentation for it has slowly gone by the wayside! The main breadcrumbs remaining on modern Google are the newer omap_loader utility, and also some references to Nest thermostats. For example,
Nest’s X-Loader had the USB patch applied
(with some tweaks added).
With all that research out of the way, I was ready to try it all out. I compiled omap_loader, grabbed the pre-built binary of x-load.bin that was included with Rick’s patchset, and also used a u-boot.bin that I had compiled myself using Buildroot while performing my UART tests with a modern kernel on the BeagleBoard. Then, I tried to load it:
$ sudo ./omap_loader -p 0xd009 -f x-load.bin -f u-boot.bin -a 0x80800000 -j 0x80800000 -v
OMAP Loader 1.0.0
File 'x-load.bin' at 0x40200000, size 26956
File 'u-boot.bin' at 0x80800000, size 777760
[+] scanning for USB device matching 0451:d009...
The idea behind this command is it sends X-Loader (x-load.bin) as the main payload that the OMAP’s on-chip bootloader is listening for over USB. Then, X-Loader starts up. Next, omap_loader sends any additional files using X-Loader’s USB protocol. In this case, I’ve supplied one extra file: u-boot.bin, which I told it to load into RAM at 0x80800000. Finally, the
-j 0x80800000
argument tells X-Loader to jump into U-Boot rather than hanging around doing nothing afterward.
The output of the command looked normal so far. I plugged in my BeagleBoard, which didn’t have an SD card inserted and also had its NAND flash erased, so it had no bootloader installed and thus it would attempt a USB boot.
[+] successfully opened 0451:d009 (Texas Instruments OMAP3430)
[+] got ASIC ID - Num Subblocks [05], Device ID Info [01050134300757], Reserved [13020100], Ident Data [1215010000000000000000000000000000000000000000], Reserved [1415010000000000000000000000000000000000000000], CRC (4 bytes) [150901f7488f2800000000]
[-] fatal transfer error (BULK_OUT) for 26956 bytes (0 made it): LIBUSB_ERROR_PIPE
[-] failed to send file 'x-load.bin' (size 26956)
[-] failed to transfer the first stage file 'x-load.bin'
Darn. The utility recognized the BeagleBoard being plugged in, but libusb errored out with a pipe error. Long story short, I messed around with a few other computers, and I found that a few of my older computers, old enough that they didn’t have USB 3.0 ports on their motherboards, actually worked perfectly fine with omap_loader. I couldn’t get it to work properly with most of my modern machines though, AMD or Intel.

data.title: Control structures in programming languages: from goto to algebraic effects
data.author: SchwKatze
data.article_summary: 这本书从控制结构的角度探讨了编程语言的设计和历史发展，系统梳理了程序执行流的控制机制。全书分为四部分：第一部分回顾早期命令式语言的goto跳转和结构化编程；第二部分介绍函数式语言的延续和操作符；第三部分讨论异常处理和代数效应；第四部分分析控制和效应的逻辑推理。书中融合历史、代码示例和理论，对比不同编程范式，并深入讲解代数效应等前沿话题。附带代码示例涵盖Fortran、Python、OCaml等多种语言。该书即将由剑桥大学出版社出版。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[编程语言中的异常处理和代数效应实现]

不同观点：
• **对异常处理的批评**  
  - tankenmate认为异常处理类似于POSIX信号或setjmp/longjmp，本质上是一种"glorified come from"机制，类似于被广泛认为有害的goto语句。  
  - 未明确支持该观点的论据，但暗示异常处理可能导致代码难以理解和维护。

• **代数效应的实现与性能**  
  - rixtox询问代数效应的实现是否需要栈切换支持，以及其运行时开销和性能影响。  
  - tome通过Bluefin系统的例子回应，认为代数效应可以通过普通函数调用实现（无需特殊语法或运行时支持），并强调其简洁性和实用性。  
    - Bluefin将效应处理能力（capabilities）作为普通值传递，避免了复杂的类型推断和行类型（row typing）问题。  
    - 缺点是仅支持线性或仿射（affine）延续（continuations），不支持多-shot延续。  
    - 争议焦点：是否需要在运行时系统中支持多-shot延续，以及其实际必要性。

补充讨论：
• **Xavier Leroy的背景介绍**  
  - baruchel和soudure补充了Xavier Leroy（OCaml和Coq的重要贡献者）的背景信息，并提到其公开讲座资源。  
• **Bluefin系统的优势**  
  - tome详细介绍了Bluefin的设计理念，强调其简单性、生产就绪性，并提供了相关文档和讨论渠道的链接。

45798068.article_content:
This book is a journey through the design space and history of programming languages from the perspective of control structures: the language mechanisms that enable programs to control their execution flows.  Starting with the “goto” jumps of early programming languages and the emergence of structured programming in the 1960s, the book explores advanced control structures for imperative languages such as generators and coroutines, then develops alternate views of control in functional languages, first as continuations and their control operators, then as algebraic effects and effect handlers.  Blending history, code examples, and theory, the book offers an original, comparative perspective on programming languages, as well as an extensive introduction to algebraic effects and other contemporary research topics in P.L.

data.title: GPS 'kill' switch allows state police cruisers to go dark and disable tracking
data.author: harambae
data.article_summary: 马萨诸塞州警方每月花费近7万美元用于GPS追踪系统，但25 Investigates调查发现数百辆警车装有"关闭开关"可停用追踪功能。该漏洞在前警探Michael Proctor的违纪案中曝光——他在领取加班费时关闭追踪器，实际未前往工作地点。警方解释称该功能是为保护敏感调查中警员和证人的安全而设，约14%的车辆（主要是便衣警车）装有此开关。最新政策加强了对开关使用的监管，要求仅在特殊情况下经审批才能停用追踪，并需详细说明理由。一起警员饮酒后枪支被盗的案例显示该功能曾被滥用。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[美国社会腐败现象及其影响]

不同观点：
• **腐败普遍化**  
  - netsharc认为美国已成为公开腐败的国家，建议向腐败国家的人学习如何应对（如贿赂、结交权贵）。  
  - zomg以马萨诸塞州警察腐败为例，支持腐败已渗透到基层的观点。

• **警察行为与滥用权力**  
  - kylecazar关注警察在执勤时饮酒的问题，提议用酒精检测仪监督。  
  - 0xbadcafebee认为许多人寻求权力职位是为了滥用职权。  
  - reaperducer对比美英警车设计，指出美国警察的隐秘性可能暗示权力滥用倾向。

• **信息访问限制**  
  - angry_octet和spacedcowboy批评网站因地理位置限制访问（Error 451），讽刺其在“going dark”主题下的矛盾。  
  - mtmail和rbanffy提供存档链接解决访问问题。

• **技术争议**  
  - gblargg提出幽默假设：若“关闭开关”改为触发额外审查会如何。  
  - firebot解释GPS技术原理，暗示信号可被忽略。

补充讨论：
- 争议焦点包括腐败是否已成为美国系统性问题，以及警察权力的透明性与公众信任。  
- 技术限制（如地理封锁）引发对信息自由的讨论。  
- 部分评论通过对比（如美英警车）凸显文化差异。

45819635.article_content:
The Massachusetts State Police spends nearly $70,000 a month on a sophisticated GPS tracking system designed to enhance accountability and public safety. But 25 Investigates discovered a loophole: hundreds of cruisers are equipped with a “kill switch” that allows the tracking to be disabled.
Investigative Reporter Ted Daniel learned about the feature while reviewing disciplinary records about former State Police detective Michael Proctor, who was fired for conduct revealed in Karen Read’s first murder trial.
Proctor was being investigated for an overtime shift where he and Canton Police detective Kevin Albert stated they traveled to Cape Cod to work a “cold case”. Documents from State Police and Canton Police show the two stopped for beers at Treehouse Brewery in Sandwich before having dinner and more drinks in Hanover on the way home.
The following day, “Albert texted Proctor a picture of two alcoholic drinks with a message ‘It’s bad!!! I was hungover for sure today!!!,’” according to a Canton Police Investigative Report about the incident.
Albert contends the text was a joke.
25 Investigates filed a public records request for Proctor’s GPS records from that day. The data shows Proctor’s unmarked cruiser drove a total of eight seconds and never left his hometown of Canton. The rest of his travels were never recorded because Proctor’s tracking device had been shut off.
The State Police began installing Automated Vehicle Locator (AVL) technology in all vehicles in 2019, costing an initial $225,000. Then-Colonel Christopher Mason touted the system as a key accountability tool following a major overtime fraud scandal in 2018.
A State Police spokesperson states the AVL system was implemented to enhance accountability, operational efficiency, and Trooper safety, empowering supervisors and investigators to cross-reference location data during timesheet reviews and internal audits.
However, a “small number” of vehicles—mostly unmarked cruisers assigned to investigative functions—are also equipped with a second physical device, or “switch,” that allows the operator to temporarily disable the AVL.
As of September 5, 2025, 418 State Police cruisers or about 14% of the department’s roughly 3000 vehicles have these switches installed.
The Department explained that years ago, several District Attorney’s Offices expressed concerns that recording investigators’ locations could endanger the safety of Troopers, subjects, witnesses, and victims in sensitive investigations. The switches were authorized in response to these concerns.
The Department denied a public records request for a list of vehicles where tracking can be shut off, stating the information would be “detrimental to the security and safety of uniformed members.”
They did share the AVL policy with 25 Investigates
in this link.
Dennis Galvin, a retired State Police Major and president of the Massachusetts Association for Professional Law Enforcement, (MAPLE), said there are legitimate reasons for going off the radar in limited circumstances.
“You could wind up disclosing information about critical witnesses or even informants and things like that. And those are the things that it would be in the department’s interest to make sure that weren’t available,” Galvin said.
In Proctor’s case, he was never disciplined for turning off his vehicle locator because he was authorized to do so.
An Internal Affairs report from 2021 highlights how the switch can be exploited. The report details an incident where then-Trooper Dwayne Correia had his gun stolen out of his unmarked cruiser following a night of drinking in Providence. Investigators found Correia had intentionally disabled his tracker to “conceal” his whereabouts “from his supervisors.”
The State Police acknowledge that the approach to using the switches “varied in its application across the Department.”
Colonel Geoffrey Noble recently implemented an updated policy. A State Police spokesperson confirmed that the new policy gives supervisors more direct oversight, specifically for “reviewing the small number of requests to temporarily disable the system to protect the personal safety of Troopers, victims and witnesses.”
The updated policy clarifies that the AVL should be operational during normal day-to-day activities and establishes a structured process for members to request permission to disable the system only in “limited, extraordinary circumstances.” This request must detail the mission, expected duration, and specific safety reasons justifying the exemption.

data.title: Open-source communications by bouncing signals off the Moon
data.author: fortran77
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了一款名为Quad的软件定义无线电（SDR）模块，尺寸为13厘米，价格在49-99美元之间。该模块具有四个天线，兼容树莓派和相关软件（如GNU Radio、Python/C++、SoapySDR），可作为独立SDR使用或用于构建更大的相控阵列。主要特性包括：4.9-6.0 GHz频率范围（C波段）、全双工、每天线40 MHz带宽、1 W发射功率、RHCP/LHCP极化、低噪声和高精度时钟。应用场景包括MIMO通信、方向探测、无人机高清链路及4G/5G基站等。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[使用月球反射信号进行通信的可行性、技术细节及潜在应用]

不同观点：
• **支持月球反射通信的可行性**
  - [retrac]指出，不仅月球，太阳系内的其他天体也可以用于雷达信号反射，并提供了NASA的研究链接作为证据。
  - [gus_massa]最初认为不可能，但通过维基百科链接发现已有类似技术（Earth-Moon-Earth通信）实现。

• **质疑月球反射通信的实用性**
  - [jmpman]提出用月球反射分发视频流密钥的想法，但认为因月球不总是可见而难以规模化。
  - [dreamcompiler]认为传统HF电离层反射技术已能满足远距离通信需求，质疑月球反射的实际优势。

• **技术细节与硬件讨论**
  - [firesteelrain]和[kieranl]提到低成本太阳能炊具改装为天线，并展示了实际测试结果（500W输出功率）。
  - [giantg2]对高价相位阵列（$2499+）的可及性表示怀疑，认为4元素版本可能更适合爱好者。
  - [cactacea]计算了自由空间路径损耗（~283dB），对业余无线电频段下的通信效果持怀疑态度。

• **潜在应用与争议**
  - [tatjam]调侃设备可能被用作导弹导引头，引发对出口限制的讨论。
  - [whatsupdog]询问比特率问题，但未得到明确回答。
  - [skeptrune]虽持怀疑态度，但仍对技术表示赞赏。

补充讨论：
- 争议焦点包括：月球反射通信的实际效益（vs. 传统技术）、硬件成本与可及性、技术限制（如路径损耗）。
- 其他有趣观点：[fouronnes3]的幽默评论“抛光月球表面”暗示技术可能过于前沿，[shevy-java]则单纯称赞月球的实用性。

data.title: Opencloud – An alternative to Nextcloud written in Go
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了OpenCloud项目的主要信息：这是一个开源的后端服务器项目，采用Apache 2.0许可证，使用Go语言开发。项目包含后端服务代码，支持OpenID Connect认证，通过文件系统存储数据而非数据库。文档提供了项目参与方式（报告问题、贡献代码等）、构建指南（生成资源、编译二进制文件）以及安全联系方式。项目托管在GitHub，拥有2.9k星标，欢迎开发者通过多种方式参与贡献。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[OpenCloud与Nextcloud的比较及开源云存储平台的优缺点]

不同观点：
• [支持Nextcloud的观点]
  - Nextcloud采用AGPL许可证，确保用户在使用外部托管服务时仍享有自由、源代码访问和数据可移植性。
  - 尽管部分功能（如插件）可能存在bug或运行缓慢，但用户可以通过筛选稳定功能来优化体验。
  - 对于个人用户而言，Nextcloud的性能表现尚可，尤其是在专用硬件上运行时。

• [批评Nextcloud的观点]
  - Nextcloud近期版本缺乏对普通家庭用户有益的功能，转而追求政府合同和AI热点。
  - 部分核心功能（如Notes）存在严重问题，如数据丢失和移动端编辑器加载失败。
  - 建议逐步迁移到专注于单一功能的替代方案（如Immich、Obsidian），而非继续使用“全能但无一精通”的Nextcloud。

• [支持OpenCloud的观点]
  - OpenCloud基于oCIS（ownCloud Infinite Scale）分支开发，采用Go语言，性能可能优于PHP编写的Nextcloud。
  - OpenCloud由CERN等机构共同开发，注重数据保护和互操作性，适合企业和政府用例。
  - 用户对OpenCloud的简洁性和Docker安装方式表示赞赏，认为其是Nextcloud的有效替代方案。

• [对OpenCloud的质疑]
  - OpenCloud目前缺乏详细的功能列表和成熟度评估，官网信息较为模糊。
  - 用户希望看到OpenCloud与Nextcloud的详细功能对比，尤其是日历、笔记等关键功能。
  - 对OpenCloud能否解决Nextcloud中存在的数据架构问题（如客户端数据加载效率）持观望态度。

补充讨论：
- 争议焦点：Nextcloud的性能问题是否普遍存在？部分用户报告性能良好（如单用户环境），而其他用户则抱怨其缓慢和bug频发。
- 技术偏好：部分用户强烈希望摆脱PHP依赖，支持采用Go等现代语言的解决方案（如OpenCloud）。
- 功能需求：日历功能被视为关键痛点，用户对现有开源CalDAV服务器（如Baikal）缺乏Web界面表示不满。
- 开发建议：用户呼吁OpenCloud注重升级策略、数据库兼容性、反向代理支持等细节，避免重蹈Nextcloud的覆辙。

community
Every contribution is meaningful and appreciated!
Please refer to our
Contribution Guidelines
if you want to get started.
Build OpenCloud
To build the backend, follow these instructions:
Generate the assets needed by e.g., the web UI and the builtin IDP
make generate
Then compile the
opencloud
binary
make -C opencloud build
That will produce the binary
opencloud/bin/opencloud
. It can be started as a local test instance right away with a two step command:
opencloud/bin/opencloud init
&&
opencloud/bin/opencloud server
This creates a server configuration (by default in
$HOME/.opencloud
) and starts the server.
For more setup- and installation options consult the
Development Documentation
.
Technology
Important information for contributors about the technology in use.
Authentication
The OpenCloud backend authenticates users via
OpenID Connect
using either an external IdP like
Keycloak
or the embedded
LibreGraph Connect
identity provider.
Database
The OpenCloud backend does not use a database. It stores all data in the filesystem. By default, the root directory of the backend is
$HOME/.opencloud/
.
Security
If you find a security-related issue, please contact
security@opencloud.eu
immediately.

data.title: GPT-5-Codex-Mini – A more compact and cost-efficient version of GPT-5-Codex
data.author: wahnfrieden
data.article_summary: OpenAI发布了Codex项目v0.56.0版本更新，主要内容包括：推出更小巧经济的GPT-5-Codex-Mini模型；合并了27项PR，涉及功能改进、bug修复（如symlink文件加载、Windows沙盒警告等）和文档更新；新增了v2命名空间支持和多项API功能；优化了token刷新处理等核心功能。该版本还更新了贡献指南，要求PR需关联问题报告。社区反应热烈，获得大量表情互动。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[GPT-5-Codex-Mini的性能、可用性及AI模型的整体现状]

不同观点：
• **对GPT-5-Codex-Mini的评价**  
  - simonw分享了通过非官方方式使用GPT-5-Codex-Mini生成鹈鹕图像的体验，认为虽然效果不佳但过程有趣（附链接）。  
  - hnidiots3直接批评Codex模型本身质量差。  
  - lostmsu认为GPT-5及其衍生模型（包括Codex）智能不足，无法完成有趣任务。

• **对AI行业现状的批评**  
  - bgwalter指出当前AI提供商为降低成本普遍“偷工减料”，并以Grok、Copilot和Google AI为例，称其性能下降或始终糟糕，认为AI实验是“昂贵的IP洗钱把戏”，正面临经济现实冲击。

• **技术细节与访问请求**  
  - vessenes推测GPT-5-Codex-Mini可能是基于GPT-4o的泄露版本，并质疑其API速度问题。  
  - cmdtab直接向OpenAI开发者请求API访问权限（@runable.com）。

补充讨论：
- **争议焦点**：AI模型的实际能力与商业可持续性（如bgwalter的“偷工减料”指控与其他用户对模型效果的失望）。  
- **隐藏信息**：simonw通过非官方途径调用未公开API的方法（Rust扩展工具）引发对模型可用性的关注。

data.title: What Hallucinogens Will Make You See (2023)
data.author: simonebrunozzi
data.article_summary: 乔西·金斯曾尝试过200多种迷幻药物，积累了数百次迷幻体验，现已停止使用。她基于个人经验和网络报告，整理了233种迷幻药物影响清单《主观效应索引》。2021年起，她在Mindstate Design Labs公司工作，在专家指导下完善该分类系统，尤其注重难以归类的认知和情感效应。文章列举了52种视觉效应中的几种，如衍射、增强的幻觉模式识别、机械景观等，这些效应多由LSD、裸盖菇素等药物引发。金斯的目标是使这一分类更加精确和全面。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：迷幻药物的体验描述及其效果差异  

不同观点：  
• **迷幻体验的本质**：Workaccount2认为迷幻药物的核心并非幻觉，而是意识的扭曲，难以用语言或图像描述。  
• **视觉效果的准确性**：takoid和comeonbro推荐了/r/Replications和YouTube视频，认为这些资源能较准确地重现迷幻视觉效果。  
• **信息来源的争议**：sambapa批评文章内容直接复制自PsychonautWiki，缺乏原创性；gyomu则指出文章是更完整网站的节选，并补充了理论研究的链接。  
• **个人体验的多样性**：  
  - wcchandler和therobots927分享了具体的迷幻体验，如机器景观（Salvia）和视觉分形（蘑菇）。  
  - neom详细描述了不同剂量和化合物（如LSD、2cb）的体验差异。  
  - ashleyn提出童年时期类似幻觉的体验可能与大脑发育有关。  
• **风险与担忧**：user68858788担心迷幻药物可能加重已有的HPPD（迷幻剂持续性知觉障碍）。  
• **药物推荐与类型**：thot_experiment推荐Salvia，强调其短暂但独特的体验，属于“第二类乐趣”。  

补充讨论：  
• **替代方式**：analog8374提出通过冥想（如shikantaza）也能改变感知，且更偏好此方式。  
• **理论与研究**：gyomu和ashleyn提到需要更多研究来解释迷幻效果的成因（如大脑发育或神经科学理论）。  
• **争议焦点**：  
  - 迷幻体验是否可被准确描述或重现（Workaccount2 vs. takoid）。  
  - 信息来源的可靠性（sambapa vs. gyomu）。  
  - 药物体验的个体差异（如剂量、化合物类型的影响）。

• 幽默和创意观点：
  - 提议使用更具吸引力的标题，如"Will this programming language revolutionize software development?"（lxgr）
  - 提议添加幽默的语法元素，如"CONSIDERED HARMFUL"作为后缀否定操作符（Ancapistani）

  - 建议无论写什么程序都没有输出，以模仿真实点击内容（gnarlouse）

• 实际使用经验：
  - 有人在MCH2022的解析器构造研讨会上使用过该语言，参与者发现构建语法比预期的更难（fjfaase）

• 技术偏好：

  - 建议该语言应遵循COBOL的风格（cat-whisperer）

data.author: yla92
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了Cloudflare如何利用Linux网络功能构建自己的高性能VPN服务WARP，以安全高效地为数百万移动客户端提供网络出口。文章解释了VPN的基本原理，包括IP数据包的封装和解封装，以及网络地址转换(NAT)在连接私有网络和公共互联网中的作用。作者详细说明了如何在Linux中使用Netfilter子系统配置NAT规则，实现源地址转换(SNAT)，将VPN客户端的私有IP地址转换为服务器的公共IP地址。这些技术不仅帮助Cloudflare开发了WARP产品，还为其后续其他产品和能力的开发奠定了基础。

How to build your own VPN, or: the history of WARP
2025-10-29
Chris Branch
8 min read
This post is also available in
æ¥æ¬èª
and
íêµ­ì´
.
Linuxâs networking capabilities are a crucial part of how Cloudflare serves billions of requests in the face of DDoS attacks. The tools it provides us are
invaluable and useful
, and a constant stream of contributions from developers worldwide ensures it
continually gets more capable and performant
.
When we developed
WARP, our mobile-first performance and security app
, we faced a new challenge: how to securely and efficiently egress arbitrary user packets for millions of mobile clients from our edge machines. This post explores our first solution, which was essentially building our own high-performance VPN with the Linux networking stack. We needed to integrate it into our existing network; not just directly linking it into our CDN service, but providing a way to securely egress arbitrary user packets from Cloudflare machines. The lessons we learned here helped us develop new
products
and
capabilities
and discover more strange things besides. But first, how did we get started?
A bridge between two worlds
WARPâs initial implementation resembled a virtual private network (VPN) that allows Internet access through it. Specifically, a Layer 3 VPN â a tunnel for IP packets.
IP packets are the building blocks of the Internet. When you send data over the Internet, it is split into small chunks and sent separately in packets, each one labeled with a destination address (who the packet goes to) and a source address (who to send a reply to). If you are connected to the Internet, you have an IP address.
You may not have a
unique
IP address, though. This is certainly true for IPv4 which, despite our and many othersâ long-standing efforts to move everyone to IPv6, is still in widespread use. IPv4 has only 4 billion possible addresses and they have all been assigned â youâre gonna have to share.
When you use WiFi at home, work or the coffee shop, youâre connected to a local network. Your device is assigned a local IP address to talk to the access point and any other devices in your network. However, that address has no meaning outside of the local network. You canât use that address in IP packets sent over the Internet, because every local IPv4 network uses
the same few sets of addresses
.
So how does Internet access work? Local IPv4 networks generally employ a
router
, a device to perform network-address translation (NAT). NAT is used to convert the private IPv4 network addresses allocated to devices on the local-area network to a small set of publicly-routable addresses given by your Internet service provider. The router keeps track of the conversions it applies between the two networks in a translation table. When a packet is received on either network, the router consults the translation table and applies the appropriate conversion before sending the packet to the opposite network.
Diagram of a router using NAT to bridge connections from devices on a private network to the public Internet
A VPN that provides Internet access is no different in this respect to a LAN â the only unusual aspect is that the user of the VPN communicates with the VPN server over the public Internet. The model is simple: private network IP packets are tunnelled, or encapsulated, in public IP packets addressed to the VPN server.
Schematic of HTTPS packets being encapsulated between a VPN client and server
Most times, VPN software only handles the encapsulation and decapsulation of packets, and gives you a virtual network device to send and receive packets on the VPN. This gives you the freedom to configure the VPN however you like. For WARP, we need our servers to act as a router between the VPN client and the Internet.
NATâs how you do it
Linux â the operating system powering our servers â can be configured to perform routing with NAT in its
Netfilter
subsystem. Netfilter is frequently configured through nftables or iptables rules. Configuring a âsource NATâ to rewrite the source IP of outgoing packets is achieved with a single rule:
nft add rule ip nat postrouting oifname "eth0" ip saddr 10.0.0.0/8 snat to 198.51.100.42
This rule configures Netfilterâs NAT feature to perform source address translation for any packet matching the following criteria:
The source address is the 10.0.0.0/8 private network subnet - in this example, letâs say VPN clients have addresses from this subnet.
The packet shall be sent on the âeth0â interface - in this example, itâs the serverâs only physical network interface, and thus the route to the public Internet.
Where these two conditions are true, we apply the âsnatâ action to rewrite the source IP packet, from whichever address the VPN client is using, to our example serverâs public IP address 198.51.100.42. We keep track of the original and rewritten addresses in the rewrite table.

data.title: Judge denies request to exempt Flock footage from Public Records Act
data.author: p_ing
data.article_summary: 美国华盛顿州Sedro-Woolley和Stanwood两市政府请求宣布Flock Safety摄像头数据不属公共记录的诉讼被法官驳回。这些AI摄像头记录车辆信息，30天后删除数据。一名市民要求获取特定时段录像引发争议，警方称数据仅用于调查。法院认为需进一步审理该数据是否适用公共记录法，同时涉及隐私权和移民执法等复杂问题。目前两地已暂停使用该摄像头。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[Flock Safety摄像头数据是否应豁免于公共记录法（PRA）以及其隐私与安全影响]

不同观点：
• **支持公开数据**  
  - [Arrath]认为数据由公共资金支持，不应豁免  
  - [Terr_]主张数据平等公开，避免权力滥用，提出“双向透明”原则（公众与权贵同受监督）  
  - [shawn_w]指出公共道路无隐私预期，类比路人可随意拍摄车牌  

• **反对公开数据**  
  - [SilverElfin]强调数据应限执法部门通过搜查令访问，公开会助长骚扰（如跟踪者利用数据）  
  - [upboundspiral]批评Flock形成全国监控网络，两党均可能滥用，呼吁民众抵制  

• **技术执行争议**  
  - [apwheele]指出警方可能本地存储数据，但保留期短（如30天），需快速申请  
  - [Wistar]质疑私有摄像头（如HOA安装）是否豁免，执法部门能否访问  

补充讨论：  
- **法律程序进展**：  
  - [1970-01-01]预测Flock将上诉  
  - [exmadscientist]尝试查找法院意见未果  
- **国际影响**：  
  - [Hendrikto]提及欧盟因GDPR限制访问相关新闻  
- **案例争议**：  
  - [jmpman]链接失踪案件，质疑数据收集合法性  
  - [carimura]揭露摄像头被用于执行宵禁，引发执法边界争议  

争议焦点：  
1. **隐私权与公共安全的平衡**：支持公开方主张透明制衡权力，反对方担忧数据滥用风险。  
2. **技术执行矛盾**：数据存储方式（本地/云端）与保留期限影响公共记录获取可行性。  
3. **法律豁免范围**：私有安装摄像头是否受PRA约束仍存疑。

The cities of Sedro-Woolley and Stanwood were denied Thursday their request for a declaratory judgment that the data and images from Flock Safety cameras are not public records.
The ruling was made by Skagit County Superior Court Judge Elizabeth Neidzwski.
Flock Safety cameras are used by many law enforcement agencies, including the Sedro-Woolley and Stanwood police departments.
The cameras record images of passing cars, and using artificial intelligence the system is able to identify cars’ makes, models, colors and license plates. Flock said it deletes the data after 30 days.
The cities of Sedro-Woolley and Stanwood filed a motion for a declaratory judgment after receiving public records requests for images recorded by Flock Safety cameras.
The requests were made by the same man — Jose Rodriguez. He requested images from Stanwood’s cameras from 5 to 6 p.m. on March 30, and from Sedro-Woolley’s cameras from 5 to 5:30 p.m. on May 5.
Rodriguez claims that the Stanwood Police Department informed him that it is not the holder of the records, but rather it is Flock Safety, and directed him to Flock’s website.
When Rodriguez requested the images from the Sedro-Woolley Police Department, he was advised that the city would seek a declaratory judgment on the status of Flock data.
Law enforcement has said the data recorded by the Flock Safety cameras is only accessed during active investigations, such as during a missing persons case.
Both the cities of Sedro-Woolley and Stanwood have turned off their Flock Safety cameras during the legal dispute.
In October, both motioned for declaratory judgment.
The cities were seeking a declaration that the data and images requested were not public records under the state Public Records Act, and if a judge decided that they were public records they should be exempt from public disclosure as disclosure is contrary to public policy, and exempt as they constitute specific intelligence information.
Emily Guildner, a lawyer representing the two cities, argued in court Thursday that if these are considered public records, it could have compounding effects on public privacy.
She argued that the data and images on cameras aren’t readily available to police until they make a query during an investigation, and that if the data isn’t regularly available to police, it shouldn’t be available to the public.
There are concerns among law enforcement surrounding Flock Safety cameras and federal immigration enforcement.
An October University of Washington study titled
“Leaving the Door Wide Open
” found that U.S. Border Patrol searched 17 Washington agencies’ Flock data. Most of the searches were done without law enforcements’ awareness.
These concerns with immigration enforcement complicate whether they should be public records.
Neidzwski also said that the AI component of these cameras adds complexity.
Timothy Hall, who represents Rodriguez, argued that the Flock data is not exempt from the Public Records Act.
He said the data held by Flock serves a purpose to government.
“The government agencies do not need to possess documents in order for the Public Records Act to apply to them,” Hall said.
He cited a 2015 case between Cedar Grove Composting and the city of Marysville in which the state Supreme Court ruled that documents prepared by a third party and shared with the city were subject to the Public Record Act.

45861829.article_summary: 美国华盛顿州Sedro-Woolley和Stanwood两市政府请求宣布Flock Safety摄像头数据不属公共记录的诉讼被法官驳回。这些AI摄像头记录车辆信息，30天后删除数据。一名市民要求获取特定时段录像引发争议，警方称数据仅用于调查。法院认为需进一步审理该数据是否适用公共记录法，同时涉及隐私权和移民执法等复杂问题。目前两地已暂停使用该摄像头。
45861829.comments_summary:

不同观点：
• **支持公开数据**  
  - [Arrath]认为数据由公共资金支持，不应豁免

  - [apwheele]指出警方可能本地存储数据，但保留期短（如30天），需快速申请  
  - [Wistar]质疑私有摄像头（如HOA安装）是否豁免，执法部门能否访问  

补充讨论：

  - [1970-01-01]预测Flock将上诉  
  - [exmadscientist]尝试查找法院意见未果  
- **国际影响**：  
  - [Hendrikto]提及欧盟因GDPR限制访问相关新闻  
- **案例争议**：  
  - [jmpman]链接失踪案件，质疑数据收集合法性

争议焦点：  
1. **隐私权与公共安全的平衡**：支持公开方主张透明制衡权力，反对方担忧数据滥用风险。

data.author: geox
data.article_summary: 法国国民议会通过一项法案，要求享受法国全民医保的外国退休人员（主要是美国退休人员）支付最低医保费用。该修正案获得广泛支持，176票赞成、79票反对。法案最初仅针对持有长期居留签证的美国退休人员，后扩大到G20国家。法国政府表示将修改与这些国家的协议以确保互惠，因为目前这些国家退休人员在法国享受医保却无需缴费，而法国公民每月都需缴纳医保费用。此举旨在弥补法国社保230亿欧元的赤字，确保医保系统的公平性。

45861419.article_content:
Subscribers only
American retirees living in France achieved something of a minor miracle on Saturday, November 8: getting a large majority of the Assemblée Nationale to agree on a measure. As lawmakers debated next year's social security budget, parties from the center to the far right backed a proposal from center-right MP François Gernigon to impose a "minimum contribution" on foreign retirees who benefit from universal healthcare coverage after just three months of living in France. The amendment to the social security budget passed with 176 votes in favor and 79 against.
Amélie de Montchalin
, the public accounts minister, did not take a side but said the government was "taking this issue very seriously." While the far-right Rassemblement National, through a sub-amendment, had hoped to extend the measure to all foreign nationals, the minister limited the scope to G20 countries. "We have planned to revise the agreements with these countries so that there is this contribution. Because, very often, there is no reciprocal arrangement," she added.
Read more
Subscribers only
The American retirees who benefit from free French social security
€23 billion deficit
Gernigon's amendment had initially only targeted US citizens who possess a type of long-stay visa that is considered equivalent to a residence permit, known as a VLS-TS. These retirees are often well-off and benefit from France's social security free of charge. The member of the Horizons party described it as "a measure of equity and common sense," though he said he was "well aware that it is not American nationals who will plug the hole" in the social security budget.
By the end of the year, this deficit is expected to reach €23 billion. "This drift undermines citizens' trust in the fairness of our system. National solidarity cannot be one-way. When you benefit from our healthcare system, the best in the world, you should also contribute to it," Gernigon said, speaking before the Assemblée Nationale. "The French, for their part, pay contributions every month to sustain our system and to have access to care."

data.title: Humanity's Endgame
data.author: marojejian
data.article_summary: 文章主要讲述了风险专家Luke Kemp通过英国博物馆中的两件文物——苏丹杰贝尔萨哈巴出土的暴力死亡人骨和埃及纳尔迈调色板，揭示了人类社会从古至今的暴力和剥削本质。Kemp认为，国家形成过程中充满血腥，而现代全球化社会正面临类似古代帝国的崩溃风险。他将这种剥削性、等级化的社会体系比作圣经中的巨人歌利亚，外表强大但存在致命弱点，可能因单一致命打击而崩溃。Kemp的新书《歌利亚的诅咒》警告我们：当今社会虽看似稳固，实则危机四伏。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[社会评价标准、历史崩溃论、现代社会的优劣]

不同观点：
• **反对以平均效用（如身高或收入）评价社会**  
  - 论据：人口数量同样重要，疾病导致人口减半但幸存者身高增加并非好事  
  - 争议焦点：是否应优先考虑人口规模而非个体福利  

• **对历史崩溃论的批评**  
  - 论据：多数崩溃论忽视历史细节，依赖笼统概括（如《Goliath's Curse》作者可能重复此问题）  
  - 补充：需关注文化“免疫系统”如何限制野心家危害的演化视角  

• **农业与技术对社会结构的影响**  
  - 论据：农业是财产权和冲突的转折点，技术可能打破历史周期（如住房问题可通过垂直发展解决）  
  - 争议焦点：技术是否能真正消解不平等  

• **对硅谷精英的批判与反驳**  
  - 批判：指责其依赖“霍布斯神话”和剥削性供应链（如刚果钴矿）  
  - 反驳：谷歌实际减少冲突矿产，员工动机务实（养家、职业成长），技术乌托邦是夸张描述  

• **权力与不平等的必然性争议**  
  - 论据：无国家社会暴力死亡率高，权力争夺是群体适应性选择  
  - 争议焦点：不平等是否本质负面，或仅为特定历史阶段（如1859-1973劳动力短缺）的产物  

• **现代生活的优越性**  
  - 论据：现代中产生活远超古代贵族/狩猎采集者（医疗、卫生、信息等）  
  - 反驳点：当前财富规模史无前例，历史类比可能无效  

补充讨论：  
- **方法论争议**：学术研究易受政治立场污染（如马克思主义者、女权主义者对原始文化的解读偏见）  
- **黑暗三角人格的讨论**：认为社会层级筛选出自私者（“黑暗三角”人格），但需分析其群体适应性根源

45861411.article_content:
Humanity’s Endgame
A new history of societal collapse by an expert in existential risk argues that our globalized society is edging toward the precipice.
Nicolas Ortega for Noema Magazine
Credits
Henry Wismayer is a writer based in London.
LONDON — There are 8 million
artifacts
in the British Museum. But to commence his tale of existential jeopardy, risk expert Luke Kemp made a beeline for just two items housed in a single room. On a visit in early fall, beyond a series of first-floor galleries displaying sarcophagi from pharaonic Egypt, we stopped beside a scatter of human bones.
The exhibit comprised two of the 64 skeletons unearthed from the sands of Jebel Sahaba, in northern Sudan, in 1964. Believed to be over 13,000 years old, the bodies in this prehistoric cemetery were significant for what they
revealed
about how their owners died. Of those 64 skeletons, at least 38 showed signs of violent deaths: caved-in skulls, forearm bones with parry fractures from victims staving off blows, or other injuries. Whether a result of organized warfare, intercommunal conflict or even outright massacre, Jebel Sahaba is widely considered to be some of the earliest evidence of mass violence in the archaeological record.
According to Kemp, these shattered bones were a foreshadowing of another object in this room. Ten feet away, displayed at knee-height, was the Palette of Narmer. Hewn from a tapering tablet of grey-green siltstone, the item on display was an exact cast of the 5,000-year-old original — discovered by British archaeologists in 1898 — that now sits in Cairo’s Egyptian Museum.
At the
center of the stone
stands the giant figure of Narmer, the first king of Egypt. His left hand clasps the head of an enemy, presumed to be a rival ruler of the Western Delta. In his raised right hand he holds a mace. The image is thought to depict Narmer bludgeoning his greatest opponent to death, an act that solidified his sovereignty over all Egypt. Beneath his feet lie the contorted bodies of two other victims, while overhead a falcon presents Narmer with a ribbon, believed to represent the god Horus bestowing a gift of the Western Nile. “Here we have perfect historical evidence of what the social contract is. It’s written in blood,” Kemp told me. “This is the first depiction of how states are made.”
In the British Museum’s repository of ancient treasures and colonial loot, the palette is by no means a star attraction. For the half hour we spent in the room, few visitors gave it more than a passing glance. But to Kemp, its imagery “is the most important artwork in the world” — a blueprint for every city-state, nation and empire that has ever been carved out by force of arms, reified in stone and subsequently turned to dust.
Systematizing Collapse
When Kemp set out seven years ago to write his book about how societies rise and fall — and why he fears that our own is headed for disaster — one biblical event provided him with the perfect allegory: the story of the Battle of the Valley of Elah, recounted in 1 Samuel 17. Fought between the Israelites and the Philistines in the 11th century BCE, it’s a tale more commonly known by the names of its protagonists, David and Goliath.
Goliath, we are told, was a Philistine warrior standing “six cubits and a span,” or around 9 feet, 9 inches, clad in the alloy of copper and tin armor that would give his epoch its name: the Bronze Age. As the rival armies faced off across the valley, the giant stepped onto the battlefield and laid down a challenge that the conflict should be resolved in single combat.
For 40 days, Goliath goaded his enemy to nominate a champion, until a shepherd named David came forward from the Israelite ranks, strung a stone into his slingshot and catapulted it into Goliath’s brow, killing him at a stroke, and taking his head with the giant’s own sword. For centuries thereafter, the story of David and Goliath has served as a parable challenging the superiority of physical might. Even the most impressive entity has hidden frailties. A colossus can be felled by a single blow.
According to Kemp’s new book, “
Goliath’s Curse
,” it’s a lesson we would do well to heed. Early on, he dispenses with the word “civilization,” because in his telling, there is little that might be considered civil about how states are born and sustained. Instead, he argues that “Goliath” is a more apposite metaphor for the kind of exploitative, hierarchical systems that have grown to organize human society.
“‘Goliath’ is a more apposite metaphor for the kind of exploitative, hierarchical systems that have grown to organize human society.”
Like the Philistine warrior, the Goliath state is defined by its size; in time, centralized polities would evolve to dwarf the hunter-gatherer societies that prevailed for the first 300,000 years of
Homo sapiens

OtterLang
Simple syntax, native performance, transparent Rust FFI.
An indentation-sensitive programming language with an LLVM backend. OtterLang compiles to native binaries with a focus on simplicity and performance.
Quick Start
git clone https://github.com/jonathanmagambo/otterlang.git
cd
otterlang
#
Using Nix (recommended)
nix develop
cargo +nightly build --release
#
Create and run your first program
cat
>
hello.ot
<<
'
EOF
'
use otter:fmt
fn main():
fmt.println("Hello from OtterLang!")
EOF
otter run hello.ot
Installation
Using Nix (Recommended)
nix develop
cargo +nightly build --release
The Nix flake automatically provides Rust nightly, LLVM 18, and all dependencies.
Manual Setup
Prerequisites:
Rust (via rustup) - nightly required for FFI features
LLVM 18
macOS:
brew install llvm@18
export
LLVM_SYS_181_PREFIX=
$(
brew --prefix llvm@18
)
export
LLVM_SYS_180_PREFIX=
$LLVM_SYS_181_PREFIX
export
PATH=
"
$LLVM_SYS_181_PREFIX
/bin:
$PATH
"
rustup toolchain install nightly
cargo +nightly build --release
Ubuntu/Debian:
sudo apt-get install -y llvm-18 llvm-18-dev clang-18
export
LLVM_SYS_181_PREFIX=/usr/lib/llvm-18
export
LLVM_SYS_180_PREFIX=
$LLVM_SYS_181_PREFIX
rustup toolchain install nightly
cargo +nightly build --release
Windows:
#
Install LLVM 18.1 using llvmenv (recommended)
cargo install llvmenv
--
locked
llvmenv install
18.1
llvmenv global
18.1
#
Set environment variables
$llvmPath
=
llvmenv prefix
$
env:
LLVM_SYS_181_PREFIX
=
$llvmPath
$
env:
LLVM_SYS_180_PREFIX
=
$llvmPath
$
env:
Path
=
"
$llvmPath
\bin;
$
env:
Path
"
#
Alternative: Install using winget or Chocolatey
#
winget install --id LLVM.LLVM --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements
#
choco install llvm -y
#
$env:LLVM_SYS_181_PREFIX = "C:\Program Files\LLVM"
#
$env:LLVM_SYS_180_PREFIX = $env:LLVM_SYS_181_PREFIX
#
$env:Path = "$env:LLVM_SYS_181_PREFIX\bin;$env:Path"
#
Install Rust nightly
rustup toolchain install nightly
rustup
default
nightly
#
Build
cargo
+
nightly build
--
release
Note for Windows:
If using winget/Chocolatey, LLVM may be installed in
C:\Program Files\LLVM
or
C:\Program Files (x86)\LLVM
.
Important:
On Windows, you must use the
x64 Native Tools Command Prompt for VS 2022
to build. The MSVC linker requires environment variables that are automatically set in the Developer Command Prompt. Open it from the Start menu, then navigate to your project directory and run the build commands. Regular PowerShell/CMD will not have the MSVC environment configured.
After Building
Once the build completes successfully, you can:
Run a program:
cargo +nightly run --release --bin otterlang -- run examples/basic/hello.ot
Build an executable:
cargo +nightly run --release --bin otterlang -- build examples/basic/hello.ot -o hello
Run tests:
cargo +nightly
test
--release
Use the compiler directly:
#
The binary is located at:
#
target/release/otterlang (or target/release/otterlang.exe on Windows)
./target/release/otterlang run program.ot
#
Or on Windows:
#
target\release\otterlang.exe run program.ot
Language Features
Syntax
Clean indentation-based syntax with modern features:
use otter:fmt
use otter:math
fn greet(name: str) -> str:
return "Hello, " + name + "!"
struct Point:
x: float
y: float
fn distance(self) -> float:
return math.sqrt(self.x * self.x + self.y * self.y)
fn main():
let message = greet("World")
fmt.println(message)
let p = Point(x=3.0, y=4.0)
let dist = p.distance()
fmt.println("Point: (" + stringify(p.x) + ", " + stringify(p.y) + "), distance: " + stringify(dist))
if len(message) > 10:
fmt.println("Long message")
for i in 0..10:
fmt.println(stringify(i))
Transparent Rust FFI
Automatically use any Rust crate without manual configuration:
use rust:rand
use otter:fmt
fn main():
let random = rand.random_f64()
fmt.println("Random: " + stringify(random))
Key advantages:
No manual bindings needed
Automatic API extraction via rustdoc (requires Rust nightly)
Memory management handled automatically
Async/await support for Rust Futures
Type checking integrated

主要讨论点：[债务在经济泡沫中的作用及其影响]

不同观点：
• **债务是泡沫的主要推手**（Nevermark）
  - 认为当前存在二阶和三阶借贷现象，即市场对成功借贷和支出的积极反应，导致更多借贷，形成恶性循环。
  - 提出提高杠杆化市场借贷成本可以带来好处，如促进技术创新而非金融创新，减少行业自我通胀，降低全球金融崩溃风险。
  
• **债务规模决定了问题的性质**（metalman）
  - 以小规模债务（个人）和大规模债务（银行或全球）为例，说明债务问题的层级性和广泛影响。
  - 暗示大规模债务会演变为系统性风险。

• **债务与资产的辩证关系**（fsckboy）
  - 强调如果有资产作为抵押，债务比股权更便宜。
  - 反驳“债务是杠杆”的说法，认为债务是被杠杆化的工具而非杠杆本身。

补充讨论：
- **争议焦点**：债务是否必然导致泡沫，以及如何有效管理债务风险。
- **讨论关系**：Nevermark的观点较为宏观，提出系统性解决方案；metalman以幽默方式点明债务问题的广泛性；fsckboy则从微观金融角度提出不同见解。

data.article_summary: httpmorph是一个Python HTTP客户端库，旨在替代requests库，使用基于C语言的自定义实现和BoringSSL来提高性能。其主要特点包括：兼容requests的API、高性能HTTP/HTTPS处理、支持HTTP/2协议、模拟Chrome 142浏览器的指纹（JA3N/JA4/JA4_R完美匹配）、TLS指纹生成、连接池和会话管理。该库支持macOS、Windows和Linux平台的不同用户代理字符串，并默认使用Chrome 142的浏览器配置，可实现TLS 1.3、HTTP/2、后量子加密等技术。目前项目处于早期开发阶段。

httpmorph
A Python HTTP client focused on mimicking browser fingerprints.

Features
Requests-compatible API

45862802.article_content:
Simon Willison’s Weblog
Subscribe
Reverse engineering Codex CLI to get GPT-5-Codex-Mini to draw me a pelican
9th November 2025
OpenAI partially released a new model yesterday called GPT-5-Codex-Mini, which they
describe
as "a more compact and cost-efficient version of GPT-5-Codex". It’s currently only available via their Codex CLI tool and VS Code extension, with proper API access "
coming soon
". I decided to use Codex to reverse engineer the Codex CLI tool and give me the ability to prompt the new model directly.
I made
a video
talking through my progress and demonstrating the final results.
This is a little bit cheeky
Codex CLI is written in Rust
Iterating on the code
Let’s draw some pelicans
Bonus: the --debug option
This is a little bit cheeky
OpenAI clearly don’t intend for people to access this model directly just yet. It’s available exclusively through Codex CLI which is a privileged application—it gets to access a special backend API endpoint that’s not publicly documented, and it uses a special authentication mechanism that bills usage directly to the user’s existing ChatGPT account.
I figured reverse-engineering that API directly would be somewhat impolite. But... Codex CLI is an open source project released under an Apache 2.0 license. How about upgrading that to let me run my own prompts through its existing API mechanisms instead?
This felt like a somewhat absurd loophole, and I couldn’t resist trying it out and seeing what happened.
Codex CLI is written in Rust
The
openai/codex
repository contains the source code for the Codex CLI tool, which OpenAI rewrote in Rust just a few months ago.
I don’t know much Rust at all.
I made my own clone on GitHub and checked it out locally:
git clone git@github.com:simonw/codex
cd
codex
Then I fired up Codex itself (in dangerous mode, because I like living dangerously):
codex --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox
And ran this prompt:
Figure out how to build the rust version of this tool and then build it
This worked. It churned away for a bit and figured out how to build itself. This is a useful starting point for a project like this—in figuring out the compile step the coding agent gets seeded with a little bit of relevant information about the project, and if it can compile that means it can later partially test the code it is writing while it works.
Once the compile had succeeded I fed it the design for the new feature I wanted:
Add a new sub-command to the Rust tool called “codex prompt”
codex prompt “prompt goes here”—this runs the given prompt directly against the OpenAI API that Codex uses, with the same code path and authentication credentials as the rest of Codex.
codex prompt -m <model_name> “prompt goes here”—same again but lets you set the model
codex prompt “prompt goes here” -s/--system “system prompt goes here”—runs with a custom system/developer message
codex prompt --models—this lists all available models that can be used with the “codex prompt” command
My design for this new sub-command is lifted directly from my own
llm command
.
Iterating on the code
Codex got to work. I’ve
shared the full transcript here
(using the tool
I described here
), but this TODO list it made itself is a useful summary of what it decided to do:
Updated Plan
└ ✔ Inspect CLI structure and relevant core utilities for sending prompts and listing models
✔ Implement new `codex prompt` subcommand (CLI plumbing + command handler)
✔ Format, lint, and test (`just fmt`, `just fix -p codex-cli`, `cargo test -p codex-cli`)
I like that it figured out
the justfile
in the repo and decided to use it to run formatting and linting commands without me needing to tell it to.
I tried running the first version of the code it wrote like this:
./target/debug/codex prompt
'
Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle
'
-m gpt-5-codex-mini
... and it didn’t quite work. I got this:
(reasoning summary) **Seeking
(reasoning summary)  instructions
(reasoning summary)  and
(reasoning summary)  sandbox
(reasoning summary)  info
(reasoning summary) **
(reasoning summary) **Dec
(reasoning summary) iding
(reasoning summary)  on
(reasoning summary)  SVG
(reasoning summary)  creation
(reasoning summary)  approach
(reasoning summary) **
(reasoning summary) **Checking
(reasoning summary)  current
(reasoning summary)  directory
(reasoning summary) **
(reasoning summary) **Preparing
(reasoning summary)  to
(reasoning summary)  check
(reasoning summary)  current
(reasoning summary)  directory
(reasoning summary) **
I�m ready to help�what would you like me to do next?I�m ready to help�what would you like me to do next?
Token usage: total=2459 input=2374 cached_input=0 output=85 reasoning_output=64
Note that it DID think about SVG creation, but then decided it should look at the current directory. This isn’t what I want—it appeared to be running in Codex’s normal mode with a system prompt telling it to edit files on disk. I wanted it to respond to the prompt without acting as if it had a full workspac

data.title: Show HN: Hephaestus – Autonomous Multi-Agent Orchestration Framework
data.author: idolevi
data.article_summary: Hephaestus是一个半结构化智能代理框架，其核心创新在于允许AI代理根据实际发现动态创建工作流，而非依赖预先定义的任务分支。该框架采用"分析-实施-验证"三阶段模型，代理可在任意阶段创建新任务。例如验证阶段的代理发现优化机会时，能自动创建分析阶段的新任务，使工作流基于实际发现而非预设场景自我扩展。作者通过构建认证系统等实例展示了该框架的动态任务生成能力，解决了传统AI工作流需预先定义所有可能分支的局限。项目已在GitHub开源并获得722星标。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于代理编排（agent orchestration）工具的实用性、设计原则及其在生产环境中的应用前景的不同观点。

不同观点：
• **质疑代理编排的复杂性**（danr4）  
  认为代理编排需要极其简单，接近原生代理接口（如Conductor），否则在LLM快速发展的背景下会增加不必要的复杂性，像是在逆流而上。

• **对生产环境应用的担忧**（maddmann）  
  担心代理工具可能导致代码库膨胀，生成大量冗余或非MVP（最小可行产品）功能的代码，增加维护难度。

• **对设计原则的批评**（djmips）  
  认为示例未能充分体现调试性（debugability）作为设计支柱的重要性，暗示工具可能存在过早优化的问题。

• **积极评价与实施障碍**（baalimago）  
  肯定工具的创意和灵感，但指出配置过程复杂，实际运行存在困难。

• **工具重叠与选择疲劳**（hamasho）  
  提到类似工具（如vibe-kanban和superpowers）的涌现，导致用户面临选择压力和时间分配问题。

补充讨论：
• **幽默/夸张的担忧**（oneandonley1）  
  以调侃方式提出对AI发展的终极担忧（如“终结者”或“矩阵”），反映部分用户对代理技术长期影响的隐忧。  

争议焦点：
1. **代理编排的复杂度是否合理**：danr4认为需简化，而其他用户未直接反驳但通过实际困难（如baalimago的配置问题）间接支持这一观点。  
2. **生产环境适用性**：maddmann的担忧未获回应，但设计调试性的缺失（djmips）可能加剧此问题。
